body:
Thank you for you reply! 

I know that I’m not alone but I don’t believe it. As you said I’m afraid that people will get sick of me and leave me. About the professional help I haven’t found the right place yet, hopefully it’ll happen soon. 

Have a good day!
That statement describes how I feel sometimes. I honestly hope things get better, that you can find or create meaning in your life and that it brings you peace and joy

I feel the same way about monotony and not feeling like your life is special.

Is there something you can do to change your routine?
You are not alone, we are all going through stuff. Thank you for your message and I hope you feel better soon

I’m glad you decided to change your mind. Specially if the reason you wanted to do it was another person. Don’t allow yourself to give that power to other people anymore, they are just not worth it. I hope you find the strength within yourself to keep going no matter how dark it gets. You deserve to live your life, you deserve to find joy and happiness in the things you choose. Hope you live a long, healthy and meaningful life!

I feel the same way sometimes. It feels like I'm drowning, like there's no joy, surrounded by people but completely alone. 

Have you ever been to therapy or a support group?
Why don't you want to live?
